description: This file defines a Dart class `WhiteboardProvider` which manages the state of whiteboard strokes, allowing addition and clearing of strokes while notifying listeners of changes.

classes.name: WhiteboardProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages whiteboard strokes state, allowing addition, retrieval, and clearing of strokes.

methods.name: addStroke
methods.description: Adds a new stroke to the whiteboard and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all strokes from the whiteboard and notifies listeners.

methods.name: strokes
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of current strokes.
